Worker reports were written to /tmp and passed to the gate; frontend build was run by the controller outside the sandbox (no frontend files changed). Worker typecheck = Python byte-compile (no Python type checker in this project).
Reviewers could not create detached checkouts in the read-only sandbox, so per-task reviews are static; full test evidence is in commands above.
